leaves.name: mumfordKLFiniteSectionAC
leaves.doc: pic-fix: K(L) finite for L ample with a nonzero global section s (L = O(D), D = Z(s) effective) on an abelian variety over an algebraically closed field (Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 6 Application 1, (iv) => (ii), printed for L = O(D) with D effective; locator UNVERIFIED).
leaves.flag: strictest reading: GLUE (review): the print is for L = O(D) with D effective, the leaf for L with a nonzero global section (a Weil/Cartier step), and the fold depends on the reading of Mumford's "ample"; unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 6 Application 1 for L = O(D), D effective, stated as L with a nonzero global section s, D = Z(s)); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, 6 Application 1: for D effective and L = O(D) ample, K(L) is finite
